jobs.title: Product Lead, Orchestration
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAD AI

At Rad AI, we’re on a mission to transform healthcare with artificial intelligence. Founded by a radiologist, our AI-driven solutions are revolutionizing radiology—saving time, reducing burnout, and improving patient care. With one of the largest proprietary radiology report datasets in the world, our AI has helped uncover hundreds of new cancer diagnoses and reduced error rates in tens of millions of radiology reports by nearly 50%.

Rad AI has secured over $140M in funding, including a recently oversubscribed Series C ($68M round) led by Transformation Capital, bringing our valuation to $528M. Our investors include Khosla Ventures, World Innovation Lab, Gradient Ventures, Cone Health Ventures, and others—all backing our mission to empower physicians with cutting-edge AI.

Our latest advancements in generative AI are used by thousands of radiologists daily, supporting more than one-third of radiology groups and healthcare systems and nearly 50% of all medical imaging in the U.S. at partners including Cone Health, Jefferson Einstein Health, Geisinger, Guthrie Healthcare System, and Henry Ford Health.

Recognized as one of the most promising healthcare AI companies by CB Insights and AuntMinnie https://www.radai.com/news/auntminnie-recognizes-rad-ai-omni-reporting-as-2023s-best-new-radiology-software, and ranked by Deloitte https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/technology-media-and-telecommunications/articles/fast500-winners.html as the 19th fastest-growing company in North America, we are building AI-powered solutions that make a real impact. Most recently, Rad AI was named to CNBC’s Disruptor 50 https://www.cnbc.com/2025/06/10/2025-cnbc-disruptor-50-see-the-full-list-of-companies.html list, highlighting the innovation and momentum behind our mission.

If you’re ready to shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to have you on our team!



We build AI that sits directly in the radiologist’s workflow:

 - Rad AI Impressions automatically drafts the impression section of reports in real time.

 - Rad AI Reporting is a full radiology reporting platform powered by GenAI.

 - Rad AI Continuity is our patient follow-up coordination platform, identifying actionable findings in radiology reports and closing the loop between radiology and downstream care.

 - Rad AI Orchestration is our emerging platform layer for workflow, interoperability, and intelligent routing across the imaging stack—connecting modalities, PACS, AI partners, and downstream systems into a single, coherent operating fabric.

Orchestration is one of the most important strategic bets at Rad AI. It is the connective tissue that turns point AI capabilities into a true imaging platform—and it sits at the center of how health systems will buy, deploy, and scale AI in radiology over the next decade. We now need a senior leader to take it from concept to a credible, market-ready product and business.



HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

You will operate as the product and business owner of Orchestration within Rad AI. You own the vision, the roadmap, the commercial strategy, and the day-to-day execution that connects them. You’ll design and run a focused, cross-functional team with clear goals, decision rights, and accountability—a senior operator, not a narrow PM.

You’ll be deeply embedded with customers, partners, and your team in equal measure. You translate health system and imaging realities into product priorities, turn engineering capacity into shipped capability, and make sure each launch lands as a real commercial moment—not just a release. You’ll work closely with the CPO, CEO, and broader executive team, but you won’t wait for permission to act.

In particular, you will:

 - Own Orchestration end-to-end – lead strategy from concept through launch and commercialization, and be accountable for adoption, revenue, and platform impact.

 - Define the platform narrative – articulate how Orchestration fits into the broader Rad AI platform and the market story we tell customers, partners, and investors.

 - Translate market needs into execution – turn customer and ecosystem signals into clear product priorities, execution plans, and launch milestones.

 - Drive cross-functional alignment – connect product, engineering, sales, partnerships, implementations, and leadership into a single, coherent motion.

 - Build the commercial strategy alongside the product strategy – pricing and packaging, partner model, design partnerships, market positioning, and rollout plan.

 - Make the build / partner / buy calls – evaluate options across orchestration-related capabilities and decide where we build, where we partner, and where we acquire.

 - Hit high-stakes timelines – own delivery against major industry moments and launch deadlines, and be the central point of accountability for unblocking teams.

 - Prioritize the highest-value bets – identify the most important opportunities across workflow, interoperability, routing, and adjacent platform capabilities, and say no to the rest.

 - Operate like a founder – step into whatever role the moment calls for—contracts, partner negotiations, customer escalations, technical tradeoffs—while keeping your eyes on the long-term build.


YOU’RE THE RIGHT PERSON FOR THIS ROLE IF:

 - You have a commercial mindset: you think beyond feature delivery and understand how products create revenue, strategic leverage, and long-term platform value. You can connect product decisions to adoption, pricing, partnerships, and market position.

 - You have deep industry experience in radiology, imaging, PACS, workflow, interoperability, DICOM, routing, or adjacent enterprise imaging infrastructure—and a strong understanding of how hospital and radiology buying decisions actually get made.

 - You have led major product or platform initiatives before, likely as a Head of Product, GM, or senior product leader in a relevant healthcare or imaging company.

 - You can operate with autonomy, influence executives, and make decisions in ambiguity, and you bring credibility with internal leaders and external partners from day one.

 - You have a track record of turning ambiguous strategic ideas into shipped products and real customer adoption, working across product, engineering, and commercial teams at once.


IT WOULD BE NICE IF:

 - You have launched a platform or interoperability product into a regulated, enterprise environment, and you understand what “good” looks like at scale.

 - You are familiar with the ecosystem of imaging vendors, workflow vendors, AI partners, and health system stakeholders, and you can navigate it with credibility.

 - You have shaped pricing, packaging, and partner models for a platform product—not just features.

 - You have worked with AI/ML products in mission-critical environments and understand how to balance innovation with safety and reliability.

 - You are energized by a remote-first, highly cross-functional environment and enjoy spending time directly with health system partners and ecosystem players.


SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE:

In the first 6–12 months, you will have:

 - Created a clear orchestration strategy and roadmap, with leadership aligned on priorities and tradeoffs.

 - Established ownership and a steady execution cadence across all orchestration workstreams.

 - Defined the commercial story and design-partner approach, and signed early lighthouse partners.

 - Brought a credible orchestration product to market against a high-stakes industry milestone.

 - Positioned Orchestration as a meaningful, named driver of Rad AI’s future growth—internally and externally.

Join our world-class team as we build and deploy AI solutions that empower physicians and transform patient care—making a meaningful impact on millions of lives. Driven by our mission,  we prioritize transparency, inclusion, and close collaboration, bringing together exceptional people to revolutionize healthcare. If you're passionate about driving innovation and delivering impactful healthcare solutions, we'd love to hear from you!

To learn more about what it's like to work at Rad AI, visit https://www.radai.com/life-at-rad-ai and be sure to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/radai/?utm_campaign=Recruiting_2026&utm_content=recruiting-job-posting-website&utm_source=recru%5B%E2%80%A6%5Db-posting-website to stay up to date!


Location Details:

For roles listed as San Francisco - Onsite:

 - This role will be based in our San Francisco office and we expect employees to work onsite four days per week. The remaining time may be worked remotely or onsite, depending on team and business needs.

For roles listed as United States - Remote:

 - This role is open to candidates located anywhere in the United States.

For roles listed as San Francisco - Onsite + United States - Remote:

 - We will prioritize candidates who can work onsite four days per week in San Francisco, while also considering remote candidates located anywhere in the United States.


For US-Based Full-Time Roles, Rad AI offers a variety of benefits, including:

 - Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision & Life insurance

 - HSA (with employer match), FSA, & DCFSA 

 - 401(k)

 - 11 Paid Company Holidays

 - Flexible PTO policy

 - Annual company-wide offsite

 - Periodic team offsites

 - Annual equipment stipend

 - For roles based outside the US, your recruiter can share more details

At Rad AI, we value diversity and provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Please be vigilant regarding job scams. We advise all candidates to apply directly through our official careers page. Our recruiters will use email addresses with the domain @radai.com http://radai.com or no-reply@ashbyhq.com.

If you’re ready to shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to have you on our team!



Rad AI's engineering and product organizations are growing quickly behind our award-winning product. You'll elevate your career in a mission-driven, high-growth environment where generative AI is transforming radiology workflows to save physicians time, reduce burnout, and improve patient care.

In this role you'll own program delivery for Rad AI Reporting, the product line that powers real-world radiology reporting, streamlines workflows, and reduces cognitive load for clinicians. You'll sit within Product Management and split your time between driving the reporting product roadmap with engineering and leading the client integration and deployment programs that get Reporting live inside complex health-system environments. That means owning integration go-lives end to end and being technical enough to roll up your sleeves when an HL7, FHIR, or PACS integration misbehaves.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING


NEW CLIENT INTEGRATION

 - Align delivery of new vendor integrations at scale by coordinating with deployment resources and engineering resources to align delivery of new vendor integrations at scale.

 - Serve as the escalation and coordination point for integration issues during deployment, triaging and diagnosing HL7, FHIR, DICOM, and PACS/RIS/EHR integration problems and driving them to resolution with engineering, implementations, and customer teams.

 - Coordinate security reviews, BAAs/data-use agreements for new integration partners

 - Build repeatable playbooks, runbooks, and KPI dashboards that make integrations faster, more predictable, and measurable. This includes tracking key KPIs like time-to-go-live, defect rates, and adoption.


REPORTING PRODUCT DELIVERY

 - Drive cross-functional execution of roadmap initiatives across the Reporting product line, partnering closely with engineering, design, implementations, and clinical teams.

 - Manage program schedules, scope, and dependencies by identifying risks early and developing mitigation strategies to keep delivery on track.

 - Own release coordination, covering QA, testing sign-off, and stakeholder readiness before each deployment.

 - Lead the rollout of major features, partnering with writing, implementation and customer success on plans, training, and documentation to roll out larger features and changes to our customers.


COMMUNICATION AND COORDINATION

 - Own cross-functional communication for large reporting initiatives, keeping leadership, clinical stakeholders, and other business teams informed on progress, risks, and key decisions.

 - Drive quarterly planning cycles for the reporting team by facilitating the planning process, aligning stakeholders on priorities, and tracking commitments through to on-time delivery.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).

 - 6+ years as a Technical Program Manager in a software or healthcare-IT environment, with a track record delivering complex, cross-functional programs from inception through launch.

 - Demonstrated experience managing customer-facing integration and deployment programs, including health-system or enterprise go-lives.

 - Excellent communication and presentation skills — able to translate between deeply technical engineers and non-technical clinical or IT stakeholders.

 - Strong analytical and pragmatic problem-solving skills with sound technical judgment.

 - Experience building KPI frameworks and executive-ready reporting to quantify productivity, quality, and adoption.


TECHNICAL SKILLS — INTEGRATION DIAGNOSIS & TROUBLESHOOTING (REQUIRED)

This role requires someone who can independently read an interface spec, inspect a live message, and isolate where a failing integration is breaking — not just route tickets.

 - HL7 v2: Able to read and interpret message structure (MSH, PID, OBR, OBX, ORM/ORU segments), spot malformed or missing fields, and trace where a message fails in the pipeline.

 - FHIR: Comfortable with REST APIs, common resources (Patient, DiagnosticReport, ImagingStudy, ServiceRequest), JSON/XML payloads, and reading API/auth errors — OAuth2 and SMART on FHIR a plus.

 - DICOM & PACS/RIS: Working knowledge of DICOM objects and key tags, study/series/instance hierarchy, and how worklist (MWL) and image/report flow moves through PACS and RIS systems.

 - EHR integration: Familiarity with how orders and results flow between EHR, RIS, PACS, and reporting/dictation systems, and where integration points commonly break.

 - Interface engines: Hands-on experience with Mirth Connect, Rhapsody, or Cloverleaf — tracing messages, reading channel logs, and understanding routing and transformation.

 - Diagnostic toolkit: Comfortable reading application and interface logs, using API testing tools (e.g. Postman), inspecting network connectivity (VPN/firewall, ports, TLS), and writing basic queries or scripts (SQL, light Python/shell) to investigate issues.

 - Clinical workflow context: Understands radiology reporting and speech/dictation workflows well enough to reason about how an integration defect shows up for an end-user radiologist.


NICE TO HAVES

 - Enterprise healthcare delivery experience in regulated environments, with working knowledge of HIPAA, PHI handling, and SOC 2 practices.

 - Track record leading complex integrations and go-lives with large health systems or radiology groups, including security reviews and cross-vendor dependencies.

 - Change-management experience with radiologist end users.

 - Exposure to clinical AI regulatory considerations — risk management, documentation, and when/where FDA or other approvals may apply.

 - Experience collaborating with AI/ML engineering teams.
